messages.content: I’ll set the day-ahead book to combine reserve income with morning and evening discharge, while protecting the required ending state of charge. I’ll then manage the remaining hours as prices and ERCOT notices arrive.

Morning RegDn deployment was lower than forecast, leaving the battery about 12 MWh short of its planned charge. I’ll top it up in the first available hour to back the fixed afternoon reserves and preserve the evening discharge.
The afternoon reserves are fully backed. I’m keeping the evening discharge and increasing the final-hour charge to reduce the risk of an ending-SoC penalty if RegDn deployment is again low.
